riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who treat safety as a core belief. Every takeoff and landing tests your skill, and across decades of flying, a safe arrival remains the greatest achievement.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most compelling part of this career is the sense of control in flight. Taxiing from the ramp, climbing through clouds, descending through weather, and touching down smoothly make each takeoff and landing a test of skill and composure. Routes also offer a view of the world and lasting professional pride.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Investigative I + Enterprising E

breadcrumb.label: 航空公司与商业飞行员

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「把安全当作信仰」的人——每一次起降都是对自己技术的检验，几十年的飞行生涯里，平安落地本身就是最大的成就感。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最迷人的是「飞行的掌控感」：从机坪滑出到冲上云霄，从穿云降落到平稳触地，每一次起降都是技术和心态的综合考验。航线飞来飞去，能看世界，也能沉淀出极强的职业自豪感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 现实型 R + 研究型 I + 企业型 E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine detail + composure + interest in laboratory work. Accurate counts and clear structures help clinicians understand disease causes.
riasec_fit_block.interest: Cytogenetics develops rigor in quiet laboratory work. You must maintain culture timing and count chromosomes accurately. It suits detail-oriented people who can remain focused, accept slow precision work, and value helping clinicians understand disease causes.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers investigation, practical work, and helping others (Investigative I + Realistic R + Social S).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「细致 + 沉稳 + 愿在实验室」凑一块的人——条数准、结构清，帮临床看清病因。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「安静里的严谨」——既要守得住培养节奏，也要把染色体条数看准。适合细致、坐得住、也接受慢工出细活的人，也享受「帮临床看清病因」的价值感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好钻研、实干、也助人（研究 I + 现实 R + 社会 S）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: The best part is untangling disorder. A contract that once took half an hour to find appears almost instantly after the system is redesigned. The whole company recognizes that value. Document management looks administrative, but it serves as the organization's memory center.
riasec_fit_block.interest: People who love organizing find direct satisfaction in this work. A document system that nobody can navigate becomes an orderly knowledge base, and colleagues stop searching through folders for hours. Turning disorder into order creates a visible result.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Investigative I + Conventional C + Enterprising E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行最爽的是「把一团乱麻理顺」：别人找了半小时都找不到的合同，你调整完体系后三秒检索出来——全公司都会记住你这份价值。管文档看似琐碎，其实是企业的「记忆中枢」。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行对「整理控」是福音：一套混乱到没人能找到文件的系统，经你手变成井井有条的知识库，同事再也不用翻半天文件夹——这种「让混乱变有序」的成就感，非常直接。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 研究型 I + 常规型 C + 企业型 E

breadcrumb.label: Electronic Equipment Installers And Repairers, Motor Vehicles

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This occupation suits people who enjoy working through circuit and technical problems. Each hidden fault that others could not repair provides direct feedback on growing technical skill.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The satisfaction in this work comes from solving difficult faults. A ten-year-old vehicle can have an intermittent audio problem that others cannot find. Tracing the harness to an oxidized loose connection and repairing it builds confidence from solving what others could not.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Conventional C + Investigative I

breadcrumb.label: 机动车电子设备安装维修工

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合喜欢跟电路和技术较劲的人——每次把「别人修不好的隐性故障」查出来，都是对技术能力的一次正反馈。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的成就感在「疑难杂症的破解」：一辆跑了十年的老车，音响时好时坏，别人查不出来，你顺着线束找到一处氧化虚接，焊好之后问题消失——这种「别人修不好我修好了」的技术自信很上头。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 常规型 C + 研究型 I

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine composure, attention to detail, and emotional steadiness. They must complete the process thoroughly, balance regulations with emotion, and remain present with families.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work develops professionalism in the presence of grief. Workers must understand regulations and schedules while responding to family emotions. It suits composed, attentive people who accept responsibility at major life transitions and value completing difficult arrangements thoroughly.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical work, helping others, and creative judgment (Enterprising E + Social S + Artistic A).

breadcrumb.label: 殡仪承办人与丧葬安排员

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「沉稳 + 细致 + 能接情绪」凑一块的人——流程要办妥也要办周全，法规与情绪要平衡也要会陪。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「在悲伤里保持专业」——既要懂法规与排期，也要接得住家属的情绪。适合沉稳、细致、又愿意对生命节点负责的人，也享受把难事办周全的过程。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、助人、也艺术（企业 E + 社会 S + 艺术 A）。

breadcrumb.label: Gas Compressor And Gas Pumping Station Operators

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This occupation combines attention to detail, composure, and equipment awareness. Indicators must stay stable, unusual sounds require quick recognition, and safety controls must hold.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This occupation suits careful, steady people who notice equipment behavior and are willing to maintain on-site operations. Turning invisible gas flows into stable operating curves can provide a strong sense of assurance when every indicator remains normal.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic, investigative, and conventional interests (Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「细心 + 稳重 + 对设备敏感」凑一块的人——指标要稳，异响要灵，安全要守。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行适合细心、稳重、对设备敏感、又愿意守现场的人。你喜欢把看不见的气流理成稳稳的曲线，看到指标正常，安心感很强。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、研究也重秩序（现实型 R + 研究型 I + 事务型 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who genuinely love history, endure long solitary research, and want to teach. Citations of their research and students whose lives change through their courses provide the slow rewards that define the career.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most compelling part is bringing dead sources to life. When a class inspires a student to study a period or person, years spent in archives feel worthwhile.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Social S + Enterprising E + Investigative I

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「真热爱历史、能坐冷板凳、又愿意站讲台」的人——研究成果被引用、学生因为你的课改变人生轨迹，这些慢回报是这个职业真正的吸引力。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最迷人的是「把死史料讲活」：当学生因为你的课开始对一个朝代、一个人物着迷，甚至决定以此做研究，你会觉得这几年档案馆没白泡。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 社会型 S + 企业型 E + 研究型 I

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career fits people who combine care, patience, and professional knowledge. Children need enjoyable play and steady development.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work develops professional skill grounded in care. Teachers must engage children through play while understanding development and safety. It suits patient people who care about children and pay close attention to small details.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers helping, creative, and enterprising work (Social S + Artistic A + Enterprising E).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「爱心 + 耐心 + 专业」凑一块的人——孩子要玩得好，也要长得稳。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「爱心里的专业」——既要会哄会玩，也要懂发展与安全；适合爱孩子、有耐心、又愿意为小事较真的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好助人、创造、也开创（社会 S + 艺术 A + 企业 E）。

breadcrumb.label: Loading And Moving Machine Operators, Underground Mining

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who are comfortable with darkness, endure hardship, and willingly learn. Underground work is enclosed but strongly team-oriented, and getting ore to the surface on time is the clearest achievement.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The work feels tangible because underground operations are a team effort. A mine is an enclosed community where blasting, loading, haulage, and hoisting depend on one another; if your step falls behind, the entire shift stalls. Delivering ore on time offers a distinctive sense of achievement.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Conventional C + Enterprising E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合不怕黑、吃得了苦、又愿意学新东西的人——井下作业封闭但团队感强，把矿石准时运上来就是最直接的成就感。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的实在感来自「地下作业的团战感」：矿井是个封闭的小社会，爆破、装载、运输、提升环环相扣，你这一环没跟上，整个班次就卡壳。把矿石准时运上来的成就感，跟地面上的工种不太一样。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 常规型 C + 企业型 E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who combine care, data awareness, and accountability for fulfillment. Routes must control costs while protecting delivery times, and professionals must balance cost with customer experience while handling disruptions.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This career develops the ability to balance cost and service. It requires knowledge of transportation, warehousing, and inventory, plus judgment about which routes deserve stronger delivery guarantees. It suits careful, data-sensitive people willing to take responsibility for fulfillment.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Practical, orderly, and investigative (Enterprising E + Conventional C + Investigative I).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「细心 + 数据感 + 对履约负责」凑一块的人——路要排得省也要保时效，成本和体验要平衡也要会救。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「在成本和服务间找平衡」——既要懂运输仓储和库存，也要能判断哪条线值得保时效。适合细心、对数据敏感、又愿意对履约负责的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、秩序也探究（企业 E + 常规 C + 探究 I）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you find value in moments of being needed, such as a patient holding your hand to say thank you or an older adult wanting to chat with you, this field provides the most tangible kind of fulfillment.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The value of this work lies in demand that continues to rise. Population aging creates an enormous shortage of care workers, especially in eldercare, where workers are needed almost everywhere. Strong caregivers build reputations and stable careers and can advance toward nursing or care management.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Social S + Realistic R + Investigative I

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你能在「被需要的瞬间」找到价值——病人握住你的手说谢谢、老人愿意跟你唠家常，这行会给你最朴实的成就感。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的价值在于「需求只增不减」：老龄化让护理岗位缺口巨大，尤其养老护理方向，几乎走到哪都缺人；做得好的护理员，口碑好、稳定性高，还能往护士或护理管理方向走。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 社会型 S + 现实型 R + 研究型 I

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who are patient, compassionate, and physically fit. Watching patients progress from lying down to standing and from supported walking to independent steps offers rehabilitation's most precious sense of achievement.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The value of this field lies in watching patients stand again. People unable to walk after surgery recover little by little through your training. Those who enjoy interacting with others, have strong hands-on ability, and show patience find one of healthcare's most direct forms of achievement here.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Social S + Realistic R + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「有耐心、有爱心、体力好」的人——看着患者从躺着到站起来、从扶着走到自己走，是康复行业最珍贵的成就感。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的价值在「看着患者重新站起来」：术后不能走的人，在你的训练下一点点恢复。喜欢跟人打交道、动手能力强、有耐心的人，会在这里找到医疗行业最直接的成就感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 社会型 S + 实际型 R + 常规型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who understand numbers, negotiate well, and withstand pressure. Strong procurement protects company profit through professional capability.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The achievement is tangible. Through comparisons and negotiation, reducing the unit price of the same raw material by several points can save millions across a year. Every decision to lock a price early or replace an unreliable supplier produces real savings.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Enterprising E + Conventional C + Realistic R

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「会算账、会谈判、又扛得住压力」的人——把采购做好，本质上是用专业能力替公司守住利润。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的成就感很实在：同一款原料，你通过比价和谈判把单价压下来几个点，全年省下的可能是几百万。供应链上每一次「提前锁价」「换掉不靠谱的供应商」，都是给公司实实在在省钱。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 企业型 E + 常规型 C + 现实型 R

breadcrumb.label: Textile Bleaching And Dyeing Machine Operators And Tenders

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: The most tangible reward is that craftsmanship retains value. Color matching and color assessment are learned abilities, and new equipment cannot replace the process judgment of someone with ten years of experience. The longer the experience, the greater the stability.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The value of this field lies in experience accumulated through practice. Experienced workers can see dye-vat temperature differences with the naked eye and correct color differences by feel. This craft becomes scarcer in the digital era, keeping skilled workers employable everywhere.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Investigative (I)

breadcrumb.label: 纺织机器操作员看护员

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行最实在的回报是「手艺保值」：调色和看色是练出来的本事，十年老师傅的工艺判断，新设备替代不了，越老越稳。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的价值在于「经验压身」：老师傅凭肉眼就能看出染缸温差，靠手感就能把色差调回来，这种手艺在数字化时代反而稀缺，熟练工走到哪都有人要。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 现实型 R + 常规型 C + 研究型 I

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career makes sharpness visible. A dull tool arrives and leaves with a renewed edge, cutting as smoothly as new. That certainty created by craftsmanship is one of machining's most tangible pleasures.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most satisfying part is creating a sharp edge. A dull drill bit leaves your hands with the specified angle and a keen cutting edge, then enters the test cut as smoothly as a new tool. In machining, good tools are made by skilled grinding, and the craft brings genuine accomplishment.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C

breadcrumb.label: 工具磨削、锉削与刃磨工

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行最直接的是「锋利看得见」：钝刀到你手里磨出刃口，试切丝滑如新，那种手艺带来的确定感，是机械加工里最踏实的小确幸。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最过瘾的是「磨出来的锋利」：一支钝了的钻头，在你手里磨出标准的角度和锋利的刃口，试钻的那一下切入丝滑，跟新刀一样。机械加工里，好刀是磨出来的，这份手艺很有成就感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 现实型 R + 研究型 I + 常规型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine structure, communication skills, and accountability for results. You must build a clear system that aligns with the business, balance diagnosis with measurement, and communicate effectively.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field most strongly develops organizational judgment. You need to understand business pain points and capability models while having the interpersonal skill to persuade both executives and employees. It suits outgoing, structured people willing to take responsibility for talent outcomes.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers helping, persuading, and creating (Social S + Enterprising E + Artistic A).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「结构化 + 善沟通 + 对结果负责」凑一块的人——体系要搭得清也要对业务，诊断和衡量要平衡也要会聊。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「组织的判断力」——既要懂业务痛点和能力模型，也要有把老板和员工都说服的人情。适合外向、结构化、又愿意对人才结果负责的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好助人、也经营、也创造（社会 S + 企业 E + 艺术 A）。
